title: NYSE owner takes Trade[XYZ] stake as it plans US Hyperliquid futures
summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the owner of the New York Stock Exchange, is planning a US perpetual-futures market built on Hyperliquid. On Oct. 29, ICE and Trade[XYZ], a crypto startup building products on Hyperliquid, announced plans to establish a dedicated US market for round-the-clock perpetual futures covering crypto, equities, commodities, and currencies, subject to regulatory approval.… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
